page: Microsoft Azure E16nds_v6 is an Endv6 family virtual machine featuring 16 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture with an Intel processor. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this server allocates 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. The hardware configuration includes 945 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. No GPUs are bundled with this instance, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

As a network-optimized and memory-optimized instance, the E16nds_v6 provides a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8, which supports memory-intensive operations without requiring excessive compute scaling. This resource density offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that demand substantial memory capacity and fast local storage access but do not require GPU acceleration. The combination of dedicated Intel vCPUs, 128.0 GB of RAM, and local NVMe SSD storage makes this server suitable for database hosting, memory-cached applications, and enterprise workloads requiring reliable local disk performance.
